title: Thai Crumble Falafel
description: A vegan twist on traditional falafel, with a crispy Thai-inspired crumble topping.
instructions: In a food processor, combine chickpeas, onion, garlic, coriander, cumin, turmeric, and paprika. Process until coarsely chopped.
Add the falafel mix and process until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in oat flour.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the falafel is baking, prepare the crumble topping. Mix together oat flour, vegan butter, and a pinch of salt.
Remove the falafel from the oven and top each patty with the crumble mixture.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown.
